Definition: Gilad, a region East of the Jordan; also the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Gilad is a region East of the Jordan; also the name of three Israelites, named 123 times in Scripture, in Genesis, Numbers, and Deuteronomy. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: God met His people at Gilad, a real place in His story, and that is why I take its name seriously. I hold that even a place the Bible names only briefly is worth knowing.
